# Revivify (`spells:revivify`)
**Level 3 [Necromancy](../magic-schools/necromancy.md)** | **Casting Time:** Action | **Range:** Touch
**Components:** V, S, M (a diamond worth 300+ GP, which the spell consumes) | **Duration:** Instantaneous | **Classes:** [Cleric](../classes/cleric.md), [Druid](../classes/druid.md), [Paladin](../classes/paladin.md), [Ranger](../classes/ranger.md)

You touch a creature that has died within the last minute. That creature revives with 1 Hit Point. This spell can't revive a creature that has died of old age, nor does it restore any missing body parts.
